direct_teacher_rule: Include direct_teacher only if every query and every document in the benchmark is <=8190 raw tokenizer tokens; otherwise omit the method for the entire benchmark (no truncation or mixed representation).
document_input: NFCorpus: strip(title + newline + text); NarrativeQA: text verbatim

leaf_cache.reuse: one shared hash-pinned cache per dataset for every recursive checkpoint, token-weighted mean, and unweighted mean

long_benchmark_decision.reason: MLDR English's published 200,000-document corpus is infeasible for an exact float32 1024-token leaf cache and three checkpoint passes on the available 5.7 GB workspace. LongEmbed NarrativeQA is an established public English long-context retrieval benchmark with 355 genuinely long documents; all 355 corpus lengths were inspected without opening labels.

metric_implementation: pytrec_eval ndcg_cut.10, recall.10, recall.100; explicit reciprocal rank at cutoff 10 over positive qrels
qrels_policy: Fail on malformed/duplicate/nonfinite qrels, unknown query/document IDs, missing positive judgments, query-set mismatch, duplicate IDs, missing embeddings, or nonfinite scores. Zero-grade judgments are retained but not relevant. No silent drops.
ranking: cosine similarity of L2-normalized query/direct-CLS and document embeddings; deterministic doc-id ascending tie break; preserve top 100

stratification.depth: deterministic contiguous K=4 recursion depth, exact integer value
stratification.query_assignment: highest-relevance qrel document; ties resolved by lexicographically smallest document id
